task: ranking agreement with editorial highlight selection
scope: 40 NFL games, seasons 2016-2024, all from the NFL channel

split.rule: seeded shuffle of the 40 game ids; first 6 test, next 6 validation, remaining 28 training (70/15/15)

label: 1 if the clip was matched to the official highlight video by the dataset authors' frame matching; editorial selection, replays included.
score_meaning: Ranking score for agreement with editorial selection. Not a calibrated probability.
calibration: Not fitted: 6 validation games are too few held-out groups to fit and check a calibrator.
captions: Model-generated segment captions were not used by any model here.
budget_note: Budget metrics pick the top-scoring 10-second blocks up to 1, 3 or 5 minutes without looking at labels. They differ from benchmark top-K metrics that use the number of true highlight clips.
selection_rule: shipped model = highest mean average precision on the 6 validation games

info.method: level minus the median of the surrounding 5 minutes

info.inputs: WhisperX word timestamps: words from 2 s before to 6 s after the clip, and 6-20 s after

probes.text: it is not a touchdown the pass is incomplete
he had a touchdown last week against dallas
that would have been a touchdown if he catches it
let's take another look at that touchdown on the replay

info.probe_note: Scores for short phrases placed at the clip. A word is evidence about what the announcers said, not proof of what happened.
